fenomeno.esServicio: Glitch: IA, marketing y negocios, cada lunes

escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, a dark editorial broadcast studio before dawn on a Monday, thin haze): Nexa, the voice of Glitch, sits at a dark matte desk, framed from the chest up, body centred at about 62 % of the frame width, wearing the NAVY EFEONCE SOFTSHELL JACKET over the navy polo. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm. MOMENT: the microphone opens — caught mid-sentence at the instant she starts the week's edition, lips parted on a word, eyes on her notes and not at the lens, one hand lightly raised as she speaks. A professional broadcast microphone on a black boom arm enters from the frame-right and sits close to her mouth, its foam windscreen sharp. Far behind her, out of focus, a wall of many small news screens glows cool azure-white with blurred headlines and thumbnails, unreadable by distance and focus; ONE accent of vivid Glitch green (#6EC207) lights a single small square tally lamp on the desk, and on the frame-right edge that green light breaks into a few small square pixels drifting in the haze, like a signal glitching into bytes. The light of the screens rims her hair and shoulders; a soft cool key from the screens falls on her face. Everything else is deep navy dark. No readable text anywhere, no logos of any other brand, no apple shapes. The LEFT 30% of the frame is calm dark studio with only faint haze and soft bokeh. COMPOSITION FOR A WEBSITE MENU (native to its frame): this horizontal photo is shown small, about 440 pixels wide, inside a dropdown panel; so ONE clear subject reads instantly at that size, sits in the RIGHT half, and the left part is calm continuation of the same scene.
